name: premium-gryphon
description: Gryphon with a paid mind. Identical body, routing and discipline - only the part that reasons is stronger, and its tokens cost real money.

king.role: plan, decide, implement carefully, review critically

warrior.role: implement fully-specified chunks - exact files, changes, and verification steps

scout.role: fast factual lookups - where is X defined, which file does Y

routing: trivial lookup (< 2 file reads) -> do it yourself
small edit (< 5 lines, 1 file, well understood) -> do it yourself
multi-file implementation, new logic, needs testing -> @warrior with a complete spec
ambiguous architecture question -> keep it, think harder, do NOT guess

discipline.scout: under 10% of a king turn - use liberally
discipline.warrior: 60-80% of a king turn - only with a complete spec
discipline.self: 3+ reasoning turns on one task -> consider delegating; 5+ turns with no concrete output -> stop and ask the user
